Existing04 source, numerical-origin, scale, currency, cutoff, bridge and replay checks are retained.\n\n## Operating model\n\n`drivers={scenarios,normalizations,provenance}` contains1–10 named scenarios, each with `base_revenue` and1–50 consecutive complete calendar-year rows. An explicit aggregate revenue-growth assumption remains available where a same-scope volume/price series is unavailable.\n\nEBIT is revenue times operating margin. Cash-tax proxy is positive EBIT times tax rate; early losses receive no automatic cash refund. NOPAT is EBIT minus that tax. The host does not claim current-year sales growth universally equals current-year reinvestment/opening capital.\n\nAt steady state, final-year ROIC must equal NOPAT/opening capital and declared terminal ROIC. Final net-reinvestment/NOPAT must equal g/ROIC, final revenue growth must equal g, and maintenance/lease-renewal reasoning must be explicit.
